   • CVR: 1.12% → 1.04% (-7%, down (drag))
   • AOV: 1,270 → 1,135 EGP (-11%, down (drag))
   *Who moved it:* *AOV 49%* of the move (hurt, -129,060 EGP)  ·  *CVR 32%* of the move (hurt, -83,208 EGP)  ·  *CPC 18%* of the move (helped, +9,164 EGP).
   *Read:* *AOV* fell -11%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *-129,060 EGP of revenue*.
     That drove ROAS -13%.
     Revenue -2% because spend +12%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *w26 retention*, its AOV went 1864.18 EGP→810.45 EGP on 2,577 EGP spend (~23% of the swing).
